'''Cribking''' is a [[Water]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Dreadclaw]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Back then, Boldclaw would occasionally step up as a challenger. But ever since Cribking's claw grew bigger than the entire body, those have been notably absent. Anyone fancy some arm-wrestling... No?"

Cribking is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A largely built, purple crab with a white underside and angry, red eyelids. One of its claws is significantly larger than its body, similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiddler_crab fiddler crab]. The tips of its claws and legs are red, and it has red spikes on its head. It's also wearing red shorts and has orange and blue highlight colors. 

Cribking's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with yellow.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "The massive claw is now capable of destroying everything in its way. Cribking trains by blocking [[Pyrodaemon]]'s flames."
